notes.title: 0.9.32 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Onboarding assistant![/b] Now included in every newly created scene, the onboarding assistant allows you to interactively set up motion capture, expressions, and integration with livestream platforms Twitch, YouTube, and Bilibili. All with just a few clicks! (For existing scenes, simply create the "Onboarding Assistant" asset to access it.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628154/c0beb5659978baf3090391cc834a05e398cffb56.png[/img]

[*] Introducing the [b]"Launch Liquid At Character"[/b] node! ...It does exactly what you think it does.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628154/c50e7e220e9d413906de4c172952450bd0c332ff.gif[/img]

[*] Now featuring [b]preview galleries[/b] for previewing everything - characters, animations, environments, props, and particles! And also scenes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628154/6a951aabf4a2c682f21b326a593cfcbd351db9e2.png[/img]

[*] [b]Screens can now play videos![/b] Yes you heard that right. Warudo is truly becoming OBS day by day. /s
[*] The "Throw Prop At Character" node now features impact particles and sounds. You can also further customize the from/to positions of the prop item.
[*] Added APNG image support in screens and the "Spawn Sticker" nodes.
[*] Some color properties now support HDR! The color picker is also updated with options to set colors in RGBA or hexadecimal.
[*] Motion player updated: now you can exclude specific body parts or bones.
[*] Expressions now support "Is Binary" mode: these expressions are toggled immediately instead of fading in/out.
[*] When not in use, character ragdolls will now automatically reset.
[*] New enum nodes introduced: "Switch On Enum Value", "Enum Value", "Select Data by Enum Value". For the geeks!
[*] New literal nodes for asset sources: character source, character animation source, prop source, and more.
[*] Volumetric light: you can now customize the side softness.
[*] Bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Addressed issue with "Look At Character" node not considering neck rotation/being incorrect.
[*] Fixed visualization not displaying for "Float Pendulum Physics" node.
[*] Subtle animation discrepancies due to Unity's Mecanim animation system have been corrected.
[*] Resolved issue of particles not starting at the correct position for the "Spawn Sticker" nodes.
[*] Corrected rendering issues with shaders that use stencil.
[*] Various other stability and usability enhancements.
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: 0.9.17 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Introducing [b]YouTube[/b] and [b]Twitch[/b] integration! Currently you need to have blueprint knowledge to set them up - an interactive setup wizard is coming soon so that you can configure gift drops, membership stickers, etc. with simply a few clicks!
[list]
[*] YouTube, Twitch, and Bilibili settings can now be accessed via Menu -> Settings.
[/list]
[*] [b]MediaPipe face tracking![/b] You can now track ARKit blendshapes just with your webcam. Simply select "MediaPipe (Webcam)" when prompted to select a face tracking template.
[*] [b]BlendShape mapping![/b] You can now configure blendshape mappings for all face trackers without touching the blueprints. To access the mapping config, simply click "Configure BlendShapes Mapping" on any face tracker's page.
[*] MediaPipe hand tracking is now faster and more stable.
[list]
[*] Fingers are now less curly when you are spreading your fingers
[*] Hand wrists are now prevented from going too far into the other side of your body
[/list]
[*] Overhaul to the editor interface! There is now [b]dark mode[/b] and a cleaner Settings page. We added a cool About page too!
[list]
[*] You can now also test invoke a flow in a blueprint by clicking on an input port!
[/list]
[*] Most face tracking & pose tracking can now be mirrored
[*] Updates to the character asset:
[list]
[*] You can now use VRM BlendShape clips for default blendshapes and expressions
[*] You can now configure the ragdoll's hitboxes
[*] You can now use both bones and blendshapes to animate the model's eyes
[/list]
[*] Fixed issues:
[list]
[*] Lag spikes when using the RhyLive receiver if the computer is connected to iPhone via USB
[*] Character root position is incorrect at times
[*] Synthetic body movements provided by face trackers are inaccurate
[*] "Play One Shot Animation" does not smoothly transition
[*] Overlapping animations and animations played by "Play One Shot Animation" do not animate root transform
[*] Overlapping animations and animations played by "Play One Shot Animation" do not update blendshapes and material properties on the character model
[*] "On Bilibili Gift Received" gift count is incorrect
[*] "On Bilibili Membership Received" membership type is incorrect 
[*] Additional bone offsets do not apply on top of tracking data
[*] Startup logo flickers when CPU is under load
[*] Editor graphical assets do not show up for some users
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: 04/28 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Transform gizmos are no longer shown in Spout/NDI/virtual webcam outputs. [/b]You can now adjust your scene during your livestreams without breaking the immersion!
[*] You can now [b]toggle an expression on the character page[/b] (finally!) . Active expressions are now indicated with a ✅ before their name.
[*] [b]Character animations are now more responsive than ever.[/b] Previously, animations have a smoothing time, which by default is 1.8s, so supposedly-fast animations would look sluggish. This has been fixed.
[*] [b]Animation recording and playback! [/b]Introducing the Warudo Anim (.wanim) format which records bones, mocap blendshapes, and expressions. You can use "Motion Recorder" and "Motion Player" to record and play .wanim files.
[*] You can now reset any option to its default value by hovering on the option label and click "Reset"
[*] Transform scale is now uniform by default, i.e., adjusting any of the X/Y/Z value would adjust the values in other axes
[*] You can now disable audio sources from an environment
[*] Fixed issues:
[list]
[*] Camera can be zoomed even if cursor is not on the game window
[*] Props automatically reset transforms on scene load
[*] Look At IK do not work for characters with no eye bones
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: 04/22 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Global Spout/NDI/virtual camera output is now supported! You can enable them in Settings -> Core -> Outputs (Spout output is enabled by default).
[list]
[*] The global Spout/NDI output name is "Warudo" while the per-camera output name is "Warudo (Camera Name)".
[/list]
[*] Screens can now be attached to a parent asset! You can now attach a sticker (i.e. a screen that shows an image) on your character, for example.
[*] Screens can now receive Spout/NDI inputs!
[*] Props can now be attached to parent assets other than characters
[*] New node: Get Asset Property to fetch the existing value of any property of an asset, and Comment to leave Markdown-format comments in your blueprints!
[*] Data types for node inputs are now shown when you hover on the port dot
[*] Fixed issues:
[list]
[*] Editor does not show array/enum node inputs updated
[*] Mouse inputs simultaneously affect all cameras with Orbit Character control mode
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: 04/19 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] WebSocket nodes: now you can send WebSocket messages to Warudo! Basic data parsing is supported (i.e., Vector3, lists).
[*] List operation nodes: get/set a list element by index
[*] Fixed Virdyn receiver not able to reconnect if IP address or port changed
[*] Fixed Virdyn receiver crashing Warudo when invalid IP address is set
[/list]

notes.title: 04/18 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Greatly improved the editor's performance![/b] Sliders should be much more responsive now.
[*] You can now [b]drag the label[/b] of any number input to adjust its value (just like in Unity!)
[*] You can now directly enable "Transparent Background" for cameras
[*] Added Steam workshop support for plugins
[*] VRM's Neutral expression data can now be imported as default blendshapes & material properties via Character -> Import VRM Expressions
[*] Added more options to Get Audio Device Input node
[*] Added dance mocap animations
[*] Issues fixed:
[olist]
[*] On Enable Blueprint node did not work
[*] RhyLive receiver causes stuttering every a few seconds
[/olist]
[/list]

notes.title: 03/22 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed particles not visible in Spout/NDI output on a transparent background
[*] MIDI nodes now automatically reconnect when the MIDI device is plugged in and do not reset if unplugged
[*] You can now override environment settings in the environment asset
[/list]

notes.title: 03/21 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the following issues:
[list]
[*] Body movement intensity did not affect the character root position
[*] Hologram keyboard/trackpad are partially invisible in transparent output
[*] Models with no eye bones do not animate bones at all correctly when look at is enabled
[*] Quick calibration does not show up (if you encounter this issue, you would need to re-setup the character's motion capture)
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: 03/18 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]NEW LOGO![/b] 🎉We love it a lot, so we hope you like it too. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628154/9c1ab4f3757e640a11bc054941f693473d004754.png[/img]


[*] [b]Stream Deck integration:[/b] control Warudo with the Elgato Stream Deck! Download the Warudo plugin on Stream Deck's plugin store, and use the "On Stream Deck..." nodes in Warudo to receive events. You can use Stream Deck to toggle a character's expression, trigger an animation, throw a prop at a character... the possibilities are endless!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628154/fb85147be7f469e3b3f78e0b7e69fb7f8c10574a.png[/img]

[*] [b]MIDI integration:[/b] control Warudo with any MIDI controller! Use the "On MIDI..." nodes to receive MIDI events similar to Stream Deck. The "On MIDI Control Change" allows you to do even cooler stuff like controlling the brightness of the light or the value of a blendshape, using a knob or slider on your MIDI controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628154/bd95d50b4904db9d97e003c3772b3eb87c240c42.gif[/img]

[*] Volumetric lights: Yep! These are the fancy lights that you see in AAA games...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628154/256201442bc6bfc90f64efd3b265e22343c2f0de.png[/img]
* Note: the visual results are largely dependent on your character's shader.

[*] A smarter and more natural "Look At" feature! Maintain eye contact with your audience when you want to, without making them feel being stared at all times. Simply re-setup the motion capture on your character - you will see the "Look At" option (enabled by default) in face tracking options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628154/480678406d5514eb6a15968a1fe6f945797f51f6.gif[/img]

[*] Head rotation and translation constraints are now available for all face trackers (and enabled by default), preventing your character from making those way-too-unnatural poses.

[*] We also added a lot of options for those who really, really, really want to fine-tune their face tracking... there's an option that offsets the eye rotation to compensate the head rotation, for example. Probably only 1 out of 100 people will understand what it means and use it. We added it anyway.

[*] Tired of restarting Warudo to reload your mods? Yeah me too. Now character/prop/environment mods are automatically reloaded in the scene as soon as you replace the mod file. Neat, huh?

[*] (Experimental) Bilibili integration. We are still working on it, but you should be able to receive Bilibili livestream events with "On Receive Bilibili..." nodes and spawn gift stickers with the "Spawn Sticker From Bilibili Gift" node. A setup wizard is coming soon!

Of course, if you stream on Twitch/YouTube, we are working on integrating with them [i]really[/i] soon!

[*] Other new nodes:
[list]
[*] "Get Audio Device Input" node that allows you to create audio-reactive lighting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628154/ea0a062aad5133e3de66c3b724dfa0c9e1809fb4.gif[/img]

[*] "Throw Prop At Character" node (and "Get Random Prop" node) that allows you to throw a prop towards a character. More than 150 animal props & ragdoll effects included!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628154/cad9c9150623d53f246c2c098624c27f43883570.gif[/img]

[*] "Spawn Sticker From..." nodes that spawn a sticker that flies towards a character and disappears.
[/list]

[*] Added a "Quick Calibration" section in character settings. You can now calibrate your trackers without clicking on everyone of them!
[*] Added menu option to "Import Into Selected Asset" - if you want to import an existing asset's settings into another asset of the same type, this is the right option.
[*] Added tonemapping mode (ACES/Neutral) for cameras.
[*] Removed buggy "Calibrate (Look At Camera)" option.
[*] Added VRM BlendShapeClips to the autocomplete list on blendshape nodes.
[*] Issues fixed:
[list]
[*] Black screen upon scene restart
[*] Upon scene reload/restart, some motion capture receivers would fail to start
[*] Using the gizmo does not always update the transform data in the editor
[*] Using the character gizmo can sometimes drift the character to lightyears away
[*] Camera position/rotation does not save precisely when the control mode is set to "Orbit Character"
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: 02/22 Update
notes.notes:
- Added lip sync and idle head animation (automatic blinking, eye movements, etc.) for face tracking. Re-setup the face tracking to explore the new options!
- Fixed a few issues in the configuration client.

notes.title: 02/21 Update
notes.notes: - Improved MediaPipe hand tracking. Finger rotations are now much more natural, and you can now set "Fingers Horizontal / Backward Bend" to further fine-tune the tracking.

notes.title: 2/10 Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mNNRxQ7.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Pekw6y3.png[/img]

Screens are now more powerful than ever!

- New content type: Browser. You can now show a webpage right within Warudo! Just like OBS, you can apply a custom CSS style sheet to modify the appearance of any webpage.
- You can finally make the screen corners rounded and pretty!
- You can now crop the screen to show only a part of it.
- You can now apply a chroma key to any screen content. For example, you can show a VTube Studio avatar with a transparent background, just like in OBS.
- You can now make the screen semi-transparent by adjusting the alpha value of the tint property.

notes.title: 2/5 Update
notes.notes:
QoL update aiming to deliver subtle but useful features!

- IMPORTANT: Fixed incorrect MToon rendering on some character models. e.g. outline width/color does not match MToon configuration.
- Added virtual camera output which can be enabled in a camera asset's config. Useful for obs.ninja/Discord collab or just showing up as your avatar in online meetings!
- Screen can now display transparent PNGs, GIFs and WEBP image files!
- Fixed virtual camera installation script.
- You can now adjust GPU priority. If you run Warudo under administrator privileges, it will automatically increase its GPU priority so that if you run other 3D applications along with Warudo, Warudo's FPS does not get affected.
- You can now press G in the main window to quickly toggle a camera's gizmos on or off.
- Added "Calibrate (Look At Camera)" option to all face trackers.
- You can now adjust the intensity of the procedurally-generated natural body movements for iFacialMocap/OpenSeeFace trackers.
- Miscellaneous bugfixes.

notes.title: 12/30 Update
notes.notes:
There is a lot to unpack in this update. [b]It is highly recommended[/b] to read the [url=https://docs.warudo.app/warudo/tutorials/readme-1]Getting Started[/url] documentation to set up your scenes again. The latest documentation can be found at [url=https://docs.warudo.app]https://docs.warudo.app[/url] (pending English localization).

[b]Changelog:[/b]

- Added OpenSeeFace webcam face tracking
- Added iFacialMocap ARKit face tracking
- Added MediaPipe webcam upper body tracking
- Added VMC tracking
- New asset: VMC Sender. Send VMC animation data to other compatible software
- New asset: Animation recorder. Record character animation data and export to FBX / BVH
- Asset types "BlendShape Expression" and "BlendShape Expression Controller" have been removed. Expressions are now integrated into the character asset
- You can now disable blink / mouth / eyebrow tracking for expressions with just one click
- Added shadow options to light assets
- Added "Enable real-time lighting" option to environment asset
- Optimized multi-camera logic.
  * The main camera is no longer switched when the camera asset is selected in the configuration window; you need to press the camera icon on the left to set the main camera
  * The main camera will now be persisted in the scene file
- Added gravity, collision detection, IK, additional shaping options to tail sset
- You can now "Save as..." a scene
- Screen asset can now display images
- Updated Warudo SDK, now compatible with Magica Cloth physics
- Added compatibility for [url=https://github.com/ColinLeung-NiloCat/UnityURPToonLitShaderExample]NiloToon[/url] 
- Significantly optimized the configuration window's UI (special thanks to Nekotora!) and performance
- Blueprint nodes are now copied and pasted correctly
- Fixed at least 100 bugs (but may have introduced 100 bugs at the same time)

notes.title: 10/13 Update
notes.notes:
Cover model: Shiratori Asuta (https://space.bilibili.com/612823436/dynamic)
Modeler: Sano (https://space.bilibili.com/43583904)

Following translated by DeepL because I am lazy. I swear I will write English updates when I launch Early Access...

[b]>> Assets Update[/b]

- Character resource animation system has been greatly renovated.

  1. Animations are no longer limited to one state of "standby animation", you can now overlay animations at will and set the mask, weight, etc. of each animation layer. The transition time when switching animations is controlled by the "Overlay Animation Transition Time" property. 2.
  2. 27 new sitting and lying postures for built-in animations; optimize animation names.
  3. Left and right hand poses can now be set independently, with 20 built-in poses.
  4. New "Play Single Character Animation" node, you can use blueprint to play a shortcut animation.
  5. The function of "set IK anchor point at current position" is added to the IK of spine and limbs, which can be used to fix the spine/limbs of the model at the current position to prevent the problem of passively catching and floating through the mold/trapped floor. (Thanks to @MistyPeach for the feedback)
  6. add the function of save/load animation configuration preset, you can switch the character animation configuration by one click through the resource page or the blueprint node of "load character animation preset".

  >> Caution
  If you have previously configured RhyLive tracking, it is strongly recommended to reconfigure it by "Configure Motion Capture" on the character resource page, otherwise you can't use the above point 5 function.

- Camera resources update.
  1. Added Chromatic Aberration, Lens Dirt, Vignetting, Night Vision, Blur, and Pixelation effects.
  2. New LUT intensity setting. 3.
  3. Optimize the effect of depth-of-field close-up.

- Props update: 1.
  1. Added several built-in props.
  2. Props can now be associated with gestures, when props are enabled, the character's left/right hand will automatically switch to the selected gesture.
  3. In addition to binding human bones, props can now be directly bound to specific sub-transformations of the model (such as tails).
  4. Fix an incorrect coordinate system issue.

- Anchor resource updates.
  1. It is now possible to have the anchor point teleport to the main camera (i.e. the render window's camera) with one click, or to have the main camera teleport to the anchor point.

[b]>> Blueprint update[/b]

- Variable system: Integer / Float / Boolean / String variables can now be set for each blueprint, and the variables are saved in the scene file.

- Node types.
  - Dozens of new basic operation nodes and several process control nodes have been added.
  - Several new camera-related nodes, such as camera focus role, set camera brightness/field of view/tone, shake camera, switch (fade) to another camera, etc.
  - New "Float Pendulum Physics" node, which can be used with model BlendShape to achieve Live2D-like physics effects.
  - Added "Trigger Resource Trigger" node, the button on the resource page can be triggered by the blueprint now.
  - New "Toggle Resource Enable Status" node, you can enable/disable resources via blueprints.
  - New "Delay Data Flow / Control Flow" node, which can delay the data transmission or process execution time.
  - New "Button pressed or not" node outputs Boolean value according to whether the button is pressed or not.
  - The "Set Resource Properties" node now supports setting transition times and jogging functions.
  Some of the nodes in ...... have already been mentioned above, so I won't elaborate on them here.

A detailed explanation of the nodes and sample blueprints will be updated in the documentation.

[b]>> Configurator Updates[/b]

- Resources and blueprints can now be imported from/exported to JSON.
- New search function for node types on the blueprint page, the search box can be activated with the shortcut Ctrl+K.
- Fix most bugs in undo/redo function, new undo/redo button in the bottom right corner, also can be triggered by shortcut Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y.
- Array properties can now delete an element directly instead of moving to the last element and deleting it.
- Fix an issue where the collapsed state in the resource page would be automatically reset by setting any property.
- Optimize performance and fix various odd bugs.
